# U79 — Generate wizard: a hidden "System" view with the splash + connection-status chrome ✅ done
*Archived roadmap item — Editor UX. Open items: [../ROADMAP.md](../ROADMAP.md) · Index: [README.md](README.md)*

**Requested & done (07/2026).** An autogenerated app now also gets an extra view named **"System"** that is **not** wired into the drawer menu, holding the site-wide chrome elements — a boot **splash** (`feezal-element-system-splash`) and a **connection-status** overlay (`feezal-element-system-connection-status`).

**What it does.** In `_generateApp` (`feezal-generate-dialog.js`), after the room/function bucket views, a `feezal-view name="System"` is created once (merged by name on a re-run), the two System elements are appended + `initElem`'d, and **no drawer `items` entry** is added for it — so it never appears in the `layout-app` drawer and is never the active view. In the view order it sits after the generated sub-views, before any pre-existing hand-made views.

**Why it works from an always-inactive view.** A non-active `<feezal-view>` is `display:none`, which would kill a `position:fixed` overlay inside it. The splash already hoists itself to `<body>` in the viewer (B71/B82); **connection-status was taught the same portal** — in the viewer it sets `viewer-inert` (`:host { display: contents }`) and re-parents to `document.body`, so its overlay escapes the hidden view and is site-wide, while in the editor it stays put and shows its placeholder. (connection-status **3.0.3**.)

**Ships with:** the System-view creation + reorder + dupe-guard in `_generateApp`; the connection-status portal; browser tests (the System view is created with both elements and is absent from the drawer + not the active view; a re-run doesn't duplicate it; connection-status portals to `<body>` in the viewer and stays put + shows the placeholder in the editor); and a `docs/TESTING.md` line in the Generate-wizard §.

**Relates:** **U58** ✅ / **U67** ✅ (the App generator this extends), **U74** ✅ (the family theme/gradient the generated app also gets), `feezal-element-system-splash` (the existing B71/B82 portal this mirrors), `feezal-element-system-connection-status` (the element given the portal), `feezal-element-layout-app` (the drawer this view deliberately stays out of).
